description: MainActivity class for an Android app that demonstrates posting and customizing notifications with various controls and presets.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for notification demonstration, handling UI controls and notification posting.

classes.name: PresetSpinnerListener
classes.description: Handles selection changes in the preset spinner to update UI and notifications.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationsOnTextChangeListener
classes.description: Triggers notification updates when text fields change.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationsOnItemSelectedListener
classes.description: Handles selection changes in spinners to update notifications.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationsOnCheckedChangeListener
classes.description: Handles checkbox state changes to update notifications.

classes.name: BackgroundPickerListener
classes.description: Responds to background picker changes to update notifications.

classes.name: NamedPresetSpinnerArrayAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying preset options in spinners.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, UI controls, and sets up default notification preset.

methods.name: initPresetSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the preset selection spinner.

methods.name: initIncludeLargeIconCheckbox
methods.description: Initializes checkbox for including large icon.

methods.name: initIncludeContentIntentCheckbox
methods.description: Initializes checkbox for including content intent.

methods.name: updateTextEditors
methods.description: Updates text fields based on selected preset.

methods.name: updateNotifications
methods.description: Handles re-posting notifications, optionally cancelling existing ones.

methods.name: postNotifications
methods.description: Builds and posts notifications based on current UI state.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles delayed message to re-post notifications.
